column1: # Class colour palette for the repeatSummary track.
# UCSC recommends <= 8 colours per track to avoid exhausting browser colour
# resources, so this palette is deliberately coarse: colour carries ORDER-level
# information, and finer classification is read from the mouseover.
# `match_path` is matched as a prefix against the canonical class path; the
# LONGEST matching prefix wins, so adding a finer rule later does not require
# touching the coarse ones. Colours are the Paul Tol / colorbrewer-derived set
# used by convention in TE figures, chosen to stay distinguishable in the
# browser's dense display mode and under deuteranopia.
